name: Coroner
description: Jenny Cooper investigates unexplained or sudden deaths in the city of Toronto. Fierce and quick-witted, Jenny is a newly-widowed single mother with secrets of her own to unearth.

videos.title: Black Dog
videos.overview: Jenny's first case as a coroner affects her personally, as she is called to investigate the death of a teen in a youth detention centre. Her own life is upended by the untimely death of her husband and she learns to navigate raising a teenage son on her own.

videos.title: Bunny
videos.overview: When Jenny is called to a luxe condo to investigate the death of a cannabis mogul, Vic Stenton, she enters an alternate world where nothing is as it seems. Jenny also starts to figure out what it means to live life as a widow – the good and bad.

videos.title: Scattered (1)
videos.overview: Jenny investigates a dismembered body that is found in Crother's Woods. Ross struggles with his dad's death.

videos.title: Quick or Dead (2)
videos.overview: Jenny is on the chase to stop a killer as he leaves a bloody trail of rampage across the city. The stakes are even higher when she realizes her son has been in contact with him.

videos.title: All's Well
videos.overview: Jenny hosts Thanksgiving at home with her dad and mother-in-law. But when the plumbing breaks down, her work life and personal life collide in the worst possible way.

videos.title: Confetti Heart
videos.overview: Jenny conducts her first inquest into a police shooting as Detective McAvoy confronts the brotherhood of blue.

videos.title: The Suburbs
videos.overview: The coroner's building is on lockdown and Jenny is isolated from her team with a blast from the past. Detective McAvoy is on the hunt for a newly released killer.

videos.title: Bridges
videos.overview: After the untimely death of a coworker, Jenny and Detective McAvoy dig up clues that lead back to a serial killer.

videos.title: Fire
videos.overview: As Jenny investigates a devastating fire in a low-income apartment building, she connects with a woman who has lost everything.

videos.title: Borders
videos.overview: Jenny investigates a body found in the middle of a country road with no ID, and few clues to how he got there.

videos.title: CRISPR SISTR
videos.overview: Jenny and Donovan investigate the death of a lab assistant, but Jenny's personal interest in the lab risks clouding the case for her.

videos.title: Unburied
videos.overview: Jenny investigates two grisly deaths in the suburbs, complicated by an unreliable witness.

videos.title: One Drum
videos.overview: In the aftermath of a mass shooting, Jenny's investigation is derailed when her exhaustion leads to dangerous consequences.

videos.title: The Flipside
videos.overview: Jenny assists Donovan on a case that brings them into the world of true crime podcasts. Their challenge: how do you solve a murder with no body?

videos.title: Monster in the House (1)
videos.overview: Jenny must trust her instincts as she takes on a new enemy that threatens to undermine her career, her family, and her own judgment.

videos.title: Fire (2)
videos.overview: Jenny and Donovan must race to confirm their suspicions before a dangerous suspect gets away.

videos.title: Bobby
videos.overview: In the wake of COVID-19, Jenny investigates the mysterious death of a care worker whose body is found in her own car.

videos.title: In Bloom
videos.overview: When a body is found in the maze of a retreat center, Jenny uncovers uncomfortable truths about the effects of therapy.

videos.title: Spirits
videos.overview: Jenny and Donovan investigate a mysterious death in a "haunted house".

videos.title: Eyes Up
videos.overview: Jenny and Donovan help a young girl who seeks the truth about her father's death.

videos.title: Back to the Future
videos.overview: After a gruesome discovery at a body farm, Jenny and Donovan unearth a small town's tragic secrets.

videos.title: No Justice, No Peace
videos.overview: After a night of partying, Ross finds himself embroiled in a murder investigation.

videos.title: Round and Round
videos.overview: Clark and Jenny are forced to work together revolving around narcotics and therapy when they  catch a case involving deceased John Doe.

videos.title: Blue Flock
videos.overview: Jenny and Donovan confront personal dilemmas while they investigate a body on ice.

videos.title: Christmas Eve (1)
videos.overview: A double homicide on Christmas Eve has Jenny and Donovan uncovering the troubling secrets of a picture-perfect family.

videos.title: Christmas Day (2)
videos.overview: Jenny and Donovan are lured to a dangerous, remote location in search of the suspect in the Browning murders.

videos.title: Emerge
videos.overview: Struggling with the loss of Liam, Jenny tries to take a vacation from death and happens across a mysterious dead body that stirs suspicion in a small town.

videos.title: Cutting Corners
videos.overview: Jenny clashes with her replacement coroner as they navigate the decedents of a fatal car crash.

videos.title: Neighbourhood Watch
videos.overview: The death of an elderly Chinese restaurant owner sparks outrage in a rapidly gentrifying Chinatown.

videos.title: Heartbeet
videos.overview: Sparks fly as Jenny reunites with an old flame in the takedown of a large corporation. Donovan unexpectedly faces a blast from his past while trying to bring justice to a single mother.

videos.title: Degargoony
videos.overview: A death in a tight-knit community reveals the holes in a flawed refugee system. Gordon and Peggy's plans for a romantic weekend go awry when Jenny falls ill and must oversee a remote autopsy.

videos.title: Young Legend
videos.overview: In the world of basketball and cryptocurrency, Donovan and Malik find themselves at the mercy of a gifted teenager in the death of a rising basketball star.

videos.title: True Crime (1)
videos.overview: Jenny pieces together a distinct body clue and realizes she has seen it before. Donovan distances himself from Jenny and Malik as he leans into a support group with his ex.

videos.title: LJND (2)
videos.overview: Suspicious deaths lead to uncomfortable truths as Jenny, Donovan and Malik come face to face with a monster in their midst.

videos.title: Our Home on Native Land
videos.overview: Jenny and Donovan investigate a death in Tkaronto's unhouse community, shedding light on a major housing problem.

videos.title: Safe Space
videos.overview: Death follows River and Dennis as they move into a new loft. A bereaved Peggy is missing.

videos.title: Blast to the Past (1)
videos.overview: In part one of the season finale, Jenny and Donovan set out to find out where Peggy is and who is responsible for the explosion at Peggy’s shop.

videos.title: Death Goes On (2)
videos.overview: In part two of the season finale, Jenny and Peggy are forced to face one another in a crazed scramble for life. A case involving a known gangster makes Donovan reconsider his future.
